codex.context: codex_context=standard preserves the ordinary CLI base context. Explicit source-only-v1 uses model_instructions_file with a hash-bound operational base and documented feature disabling; accepted scientific instruction bytes remain in the task prompt. Token reduction and scientific quality require separate measured qualification.
codex.compatibility_note: The local CLI rejects the documented tools.view_image key under strict config; this optional toggle is omitted. Observed external/tool activity still invalidates a source-only response. Unknown CLI config errors are retained as sanitized operational diagnostics.
codex.billing: Signed-in ChatGPT only; forced login method and ambient API configuration removal.
codex.validation: Mock adapter tests; live deployment qualification is separate.

claude.requires: CLI 2.1.293 or later, --safe-mode and --restricted, native --effort and --json-schema. --bare is deliberately absent because it disables subscription auth.
claude.billing: Subscription authMethod claude.ai/oauth_token plus operator confirmation of disabled extra usage/usage credits required; no API fallback or Fable credit-only model.
claude.validation: Mock adapter tests only; no scientific qualification asserted.

openclaw.status: Use manual exchange or an explicit reviewed command wrapper. No built-in alias claims source-only isolation or billing verification.
openclaw.reason: Agent execution can enable tools and configured runtime behavior; a wrapper must establish a compatible source-only result contract.

openai-compatible.status: Explicit JSON-compatible Chat Completions endpoint; provider compatibility and model qualification are separate.
openai-compatible.limitations: No fallback to another response format, model, endpoint or billing route. Remote endpoints require HTTPS and spending authorization.
